body:
Repairs F01–F10: inspection now respects each record’s scope; callbacks retain their original authority; post-effect reconnects preserve uncertainty and recovery fences; cached replies and assessments enforce current inputs; overlapping native work stays visible. The independent checker preserves raw disagreements, latest attempts, required timing and aggregate completion state. Both calibrators require the intended executed assertion.

Stacked on draft PR #5 (`repair/behavioral-preservation`, `b0a00f1`). The original review/evidence and parallel Jev experiment remain unchanged. No merge was performed.

Measured candidate: `ef7567516520543970af55b6f19534cb66eda357`; tree `a0813aae760e6e5bb6245693bd92b7e7c321348b`.

- [Final hosted CI](https://github.com/xormania/xorchestrate/actions/runs/40066679349): all six jobs passed. Python 3.11/3.12 each passed **809 tests + 164 subtests**, with no skips. The integration tree exactly equals the candidate.
- Local: **799 passed + 164 subtests**, with ten measured host limitations covered by CI.
- All **89 original selectors** and **165 total H/B/A selectors** passed locally and hosted. **211** new regression/calibration cases remain in normal CI.
- Actual composed protocol: **46/46** locally and hosted; both raw reports recompute exactly.
- All **12 original activated source faults** detected; independent audit verified **36 passing controls, 19 intended assertion failures**, zero errors/skips. Additional behavioral and corrupt-evidence faults remain retained.
- Live tmux: 22 tests plus fixture, verified cleanup. Historical preservation: 285 toolkit + 825 runtime tests, no skips. Static checks passed.

[Repair report](https://github.com/xormania/xorchestrate/blob/663f0634f59c5d6f6c54910c8f995a6af9e6a490/docs/repair/evidence/Xorchestrate-Repair-Report.md) · [Closure matrix](https://github.com/xormania/xorchestrate/blob/663f0634f59c5d6f6c54910c8f995a6af9e6a490/docs/repair/evidence/closure-matrix.json) · [H/B/A mapping](https://github.com/xormania/xorchestrate/blob/663f0634f59c5d6f6c54910c8f995a6af9e6a490/docs/repair/evidence/requirement-matrix.md) · [Exact manifest](https://github.com/xormania/xorchestrate/blob/663f0634f59c5d6f6c54910c8f995a6af9e6a490/docs/repair/evidence/final-manifest.json) · [Replay guide](https://github.com/xormania/xorchestrate/blob/663f0634f59c5d6f6c54910c8f995a6af9e6a490/docs/repair/evidence/REPLAY.md)

Evidence publication `663f0634f59c5d6f6c54910c8f995a6af9e6a490` is a separate documentation-only child on `evidence/independent-findings-ef75675`; the PR head remains the measured source. The full handoff package retains the original ZIP, raw observations, logs/JUnit, fault definitions, failed/superseded attempts and hash-verified source recovery.

Authenticated vendor acceptance remains pending xor’s local run. Fresh-session independent verification remains pending. Older Codex/Grok captures lack aggregate completion state and are truthfully incomplete under the corrected checker; final captures provide the required evidence.
